role_summary: Hands-on strategic leader responsible for IT infrastructure, hybrid/multi-cloud operations, and digital transformation, leading the team through modernization and business-aligned IT delivery.
must_have_requirements: Degree in Computer Science or related discipline
Minimum 15 years experience in IT infrastructure, operations, or cloud services
Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role
Proven experience in hybrid or multi-cloud environment management (AWS, Azure, Ali Cloud)
Significant experience in infrastructure modernization or cloud migrations
Proven ability to manage vendors and managed service providers (MSPs)
Experience translating business strategy into IT infrastructure/operational initiatives
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience in the Chinese Mainland market
Professional certifications (AWS/Azure Architect, CISSP, ITIL, PMP)

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud Infrastructure Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Direct mandate for managing multi-cloud stewardship and modernization.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates without hands-on multi-cloud migration experience

scoring_criteria.name: Senior Management Tenure
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires 15+ years total / 5+ years senior to lead organizational change.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates with under 5 years in leadership

scoring_criteria.name: Business-Aligned Transformation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role must turn IT into a value-adding business unit.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates focusing solely on technical maintenance

scoring_criteria.name: Vendor and MSP Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Utilizes external capability to drive scale.

scoring_criteria.name: Security Integration
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Mandatory collaboration with cyber teams in operations design.

scoring_criteria.name: Team Development & Talent Retention
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Focus on high-performing team building and competency frameworks.

scoring_criteria.name: Geographic Market Relevance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Chinese Mainland or multi-cultural experience preferred.

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requirement to act as bridge between Business stakeholders and IT execution.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Alignment of IT roadmap to business goals

summary_focus: Highlight transition from functional IT management to business-aligned strategic growth.
Quantify infrastructure modernization and cloud savings.
do_not_overclaim: Avoid claiming security expertise if the candidate only has infrastructure management experience without clear security compliance alignment.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position as a partner for business transformation rather than just a technologist.
bridge_gaps_honestly: Focus on the candidate's transferrable ability to lead complex cultural/organizational changes if they do not have direct 'Makers' heritage.
